120mm long lasting fan provides superior cooling with minimal noise.
HEXA+ Series also provides PCI-Express graphic card connector(s) and 4 units above SATA cable to take
care of your need for storage.
Built with quality components and dual +12V outputs, HEXA+ Series ensures stabilityand reliability for your system.
Besides, HEXA+ Series also protects your PC by providing complete protection
(OCP, OVP, SCP) and multiple safety approvals.
Compared with HEXA series, HEXA+ series is with longer length of 24 Pin also 4+4 Pin cable,
it’s much convenient for you to assemble.
HEXA+ Series dose the job efficiently and reliably, making it a stable power supply unit built to satisfy
the demands on users looking for entry-level power or the budget minded system builder.
